findings.summary: Production exact-open exposed an EVIDENCE root but no bounded public group/page dereference API; the verification facade assembled all 100000 events in one response.
Production lifespan registered the factory but not real binding, recovery, and foreground scheduler ports, so fixture-only ports masked unavailable production operations.
Recovery drain_or_park enumerated IDs but hard-coded gap_count=0 without durable item parking, lease revocation, or worker watermark acknowledgement.

note: This is a Phase 3 code-audit. Testcase, scenario, root-run, and terminal evidence are intentionally not counted yet.
